metadata.title: Vintage Analog Baby Portrait with Hand-Drawn Overlays

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-fidelity, warm-toned analog photograph of an infant held by adult hands, featuring physical-looking overlays like masking tape and felt-tip marker handwriting, finished with heavy film wear and light leaks.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-texture: The baby is partially obscured by scratches and dust, grounding it in a physical era.
Text-to-material: Handwriting appears directly on the photo surface and on a piece of masking tape.
Color-to-mood: Desaturated skin tones and cyan-leaning shadows evoke a late 90s/early 2000s consumer film print.
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and surface scratches
Masking tape strip at the bottom third
Hand-drawn marker aesthetic for all text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Infant centered vertically, cropped from head to mid-thigh, held by hands entering from the top and sides.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The baby's face and the high-contrast masking tape at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the baby's eyes, moves to the top-left handwritten name, then down to the date on the tape.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with the subject and the supporting hands, creating an intimate, crowded feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and peach skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy and cyan in the background shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white/tan of the masking tape and black ink of the marker.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a compressed dynamic range, typical of aged physical prints.

letterConstructionRules: Varying line weight consistent with a felt-tip marker
Connected lowercase letters in the top-left script
Disconnected, rounded numerals on the tape
characterSpecificRedesigns: Double underline beneath the top name for emphasis
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Casual script paired with simplified block numerals for a 'scrapbook' feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the date on the tape.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage 2000s-style analog photo of a baby being held by adult hands. Apply heavy film grain, scratches, and a warm, slightly faded color grade. Include a piece of tan masking tape horizontally across the bottom third of the image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a black felt-tip marker style, add a handwritten name in the top-left corner with a double underline. Add a handwritten four-digit year in the center of the masking tape strip.

verificationChecks: Does the text look like it was written with a physical marker?
Is the masking tape texture realistic with torn edges?
Is the film grain and scratch overlay consistent across the whole frame?

adjustableVariables: Angle and length of the masking tape
Warmth of the photo color temperature
postGenerationChecks: Check for 'ink bleed' on the text edges.
Ensure the tape looks like it is sitting on top of the photo.
Verify the baby's expression is candid and not overly posed.
Confirm the film damage doesn't obscure the main facial features.
recipe.reuseFormula: Analog Portrait + Hand-drawn Marker Script + Masking Tape Prop + Heavy Film Wear Overlay.
